Then call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount equal to that integer. But note: The fuel tank can hold up to 50 gallons. 150 liters is about 39.68 gallons. Rounded to nearest integer is 40 gallons. That is within capacity. So we can fill 40 gallons. Then start engine with ignitionMode "START". So we need to call two functions: liter_to_gallon, then fillFuelTank, then startEngine. But we need to do them sequentially. We'll first call liter_to_gallon. Then after receiving result, compute rounded integer. Then call fillFuelTank. Then call startEngine. Let's do that.
